draft_frames.purpose: 为三只哈士奇主体提供统一角色外观锚点，保证个体A与 dog.jpeg 外观一致、其余同品种个体一致
draft_frames.prompt: Pure person (character) reference image of a Siberian Husky actor dog: a single medium-large husky standing calmly, full body visible, centered and facing the camera, isolated on a plain seamless light-gray studio background with soft even lighting; no other animals, no people, no scene props, no text, no logo, no watermark. Appearance: black-white-gray double coat, deep gray-black back and ear tops, white chest, belly and inner legs, white facial mask with a darker eye mask, erect triangular ears, white-tipped bushy curled tail, heterochromatic eyes (one brown, one blue), mouth open with the tongue out, long athletic legs, alert friendly lively expression. Photorealistic, sharp fur texture, natural anatomy, documentary realism, eye-level camera, sharp focus on the dog. This is a pure character appearance reference only; keep the background clean and neutral so the subject identity is the only content.
must_include: white facial mask with darker eye mask
full body, facing camera, plain neutral background

draft_frames.purpose: 为户外草坪提供统一场景锚点，固定草地、日光、色调与空间层次
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference image of an outdoor park lawn with no people and no animals: an open, neatly mown green lawn in bright natural daylight under an open sky; visible grass blade texture, a few scattered leaves and grass clippings, soft natural shadows on the grass; a distant row of trees and low hedges forming a low background band along the far edge, with a pale blue sky above; green and yellow-green color palette, medium-low contrast, gentle depth-of-field falloff toward the background trees, low background density. Photorealistic documentary look, standard lens, stable eye-level camera. No indoor furniture, no buildings, no vending machines, no vending-machine graphics, no logos, no text, no watermark, no people, no dogs. This is a pure environment reference only.
must_include: neatly mown green grass with blade texture
distant row of trees and low hedges
no people, no animals, no text, no logo

consistency_review.global_style_brief: 明亮自然日光下的真实纪实户外质感，中低反差，标准镜头，主体清晰、背景适度虚化；不使用任何参考片品牌、文字、logo 与室内专属道具。
global_negative_constraints: no readable text, logo, watermark or corner mark
no indoor reference set dressing (vending machine, sofa, yellow chair, cartoon standee, floor circle marking)
keep the husky as the only subject type in the person frame; keep the lawn free of people/animals in the scene frame
